content: Following a consensual separation, the wife sought the division of jointly held bank accounts and stock deposits, while the husband alleged a verbal agreement to use the funds for finishing a building for their children. Under Art. 2722 CC, oral evidence is inadmissible to prove agreements contrary to the content of a written document, such as a formal separation agreement that generically settles property relations. Regarding the nature of the assets, funds held in bank accounts at the time of dissolution fall into the comunione de residuo under Art. 177(c) CC. To exclude such sums, the holder must prove they were either personal under Art. 179 CC or already consumed for family needs prior to dissolution; otherwise, they are subject to equal division.
